about: Leads for Seia (Serra da Estrela), started from a reader tip on r/Lisbon, 2026-10-22.

leads.name: The Chestnuts of Souto da Lapa
leads.place: Souto da Lapa, Lapa dos Dinheiros, Seia, Serra da Estrela
leads.source: reader tip on r/Lisbon, 2026-10-22 (no name kept): 'castanheiros centenários e milenares de troncos gigantescos e cavidades impressionantes', one that eight people could not reach around; coordinates are the village, not a trunk
leads.note: A grove, so the collectible point is the one trunk worth the walk (the eight-person chestnut). Needs: which tree, its position, a source for its age (the Seia municipality or ICNF; the ICNF register has only the Solar de Santa Rita yew for this parish), and an open-licence photograph. The tipster posted a photo of one trunk in the thread (reddit.com/r/Lisbon/comments/1xci4vn/comment/19ri7whjaowhu); permission to use it asked 2026-10-23, a written yes in the thread is the permission. Day trip from Seia; not a Lisbon tree.
